name: Rouge Wentworth
original_name: ルージュ ウェントワース
source: Ojousama and waitress from the most popular restaurant in Eleutheria. She gives Unica high credit for her cooking skill but always fails to recruit her. She got kicked out when trying to steal the owner rights of the restaurant from her own mother. Having nowhere to go, she joins Unica's Daft Dream Diner as waitress.
